To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

for a deformation parameter q = exp(2pi i / (k + n)) the WZNW model has a finite number N = 2h of superselection sectors, and that these sectors are in one to one correspondence with the finite dimensional irreducible representations of the quantum algebra M(n, q).

the left and right zero mode sectors of the WZNW model at level k and with a deformation parameter q = e^{2\pi i/h}, h= k + n, are isomorphic to the left and right quantum matrix algebrs of size k x k, that each of them has an ideal such that its factor algebra is finite-dimensional and that the structure of the superselection sectors of a diagonal WZNW model with the above parameters is reduced to a finite-dimensional gauge problem

the left and right zero mode sectors of the level k = 1 SU(n) Wess-Zumino-Novikov-Witten (WZNW) model are isomorphic and mutually commuting, and that each sector admits a finite-dimensional ideal such that the resulting factor algebra has dimension (n-1)(2h-1).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure of the WZNW model on the cylinder, i.e. the model on the 1+1 dimensional torus.
the study of the WZNW model on the plane, with a focus on the quantum group symmetry of the model, and on the problem of the superselection sectors.
the structure of the WZNW model at the critical point.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 2D WZW model is an example of a gauge theory in which the structure of superselection sector is reduced to a finite-dimensional gauge problem.

the WZNW model on the torus with a rational level k is a quantum field theory with a finite number of superselection sectors and that the superselection sectors are in one to one correspondence with irreducible representations of the quantum matrix algebra.

, for the WZNW model with the level k SU(2) gauge group, the superselection sectors of its diagonal (i.e., the WZNW field is diagonalized) representation theory are in a one-to-one correspondence with the superselection sectors (in the same sense) of the finite-dimensional gauge problem with the group SU(2) and the gauge field strength given by the left zero mode of the WZNW action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the WZNW model with q being an even root of unity can be considered as a gauge theory with a finite number of degrees of freedom.
the (left and right ) quantum matrix algebas are equivalent to the quantum group algebras.
for a given q we can find an explicit basis of the space of the superselection sectors of a 2D WZWN model with a diagonal current algebra of the level k.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of the superselection sectors of a conformal field theory can be reduced to a finite dimensiona problem of a gauge theoretic nature.
the WZNW model at a root of unity is a good candidate for an example of the so-called topological quantum field theory (TQFT) in 2D.
the structure of superselection charges in 2D WZW models is closely related to the structure of quantum matrix algebrs.
